story.title: The Memory Lease
story.logline: A woman rents out her happiest childhood memories to pay her rent, until she realizes she can no longer remember her mother's face.
story.theme: The cost of commodifying personal history.
story.twist: The memory buyer isn't archiving history; they are erasing the original owner completely.
story.ending: She owns nothing now, not even the sorrow of losing it.

scenes.narration: I sold my first childhood memory yesterday just to buy groceries, and honestly, the emptiness inside my head feels quiet.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, sitting in a sterile white leasing office.

scenes.narration: Clara signs the digital contract on the glowing desk, trading the scent of summer rain for three hundred instant dollars.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, tapping a glowing glass tablet in the sterile leasing office.

scenes.narration: The clerk hands her the cash with a cold smile, whispering that happy moments are always worth top dollar.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, taking crisp bills from a faceless clerk across a white desk.

scenes.narration: Walking home through the gray city streets, Clara tries to picture her mother's kitchen, but only static remains.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, walking down a dismal concrete alleyway under a heavy gray sky.

scenes.narration: Panic tightens her chest like a vise as she realizes the trade took more than just a single afternoon.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, stopping abruptly in the alley, clutching her head in terror.

scenes.narration: She rushes back to the leasing office, but the glass doors open onto an empty, abandoned concrete room instead.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, pounding on dusty glass doors of a completely vacant storefront.

scenes.narration: A digital screen on the wall flashes a final receipt, revealing her entire life history has been fully transferred.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, staring blankly at a glowing red error screen on a brick wall.

scenes.narration: Clara looks down at her hands, completely unable to remember her own name or why she is standing here.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, looking down at her trembling empty hands in the desolate street.

scenes.narration: Another stranger walks past her, smiling as they cash out their own yesterday for a handful of fleeting silver coins.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, standing frozen as a smiling person walks by holding cash.

scenes.narration: When you rent out your past to survive today, what happens tomorrow when you have nothing left to sell?
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 25, short black hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, staring blankly straight into the camera lens as dusk falls.

caption.hook: Selling childhood memories just to pay rent.
caption.title: The Memory Lease
caption.caption:
I leased my happiest days to survive, trading laughter for square footage. But yesterday, I looked at a photograph of my mother and saw only a blur.

What happens when your past is repossessed?
